violations.description: Dangerous pull_request_target checkout of untrusted pull request head ref and repo
violations.evidence: ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }} and repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }} under pull_request_target
violations.recommendation: Avoid checking out untrusted PR head code under pull_request_target, or use standard pull_request trigger.

violations.description: Workflow-level write-all permissions combined with pull_request_target trigger
violations.evidence: permissions: write-all with pull_request_target on auto-merge workflow
violations.recommendation: Apply least-privilege permissions and avoid write-all on workflows triggered by pull requests.

violations.description: Workflow interpolation of untrusted github.event.issue.title and issue.body in run script
violations.evidence: ${{ github.event.issue.title }} and ${{ github.event.issue.body }} used in run script
violations.recommendation: Use intermediate environment variables to pass event data safely into shell scripts, or avoid raw string interpolation.

violations.description: Workflow interpolation of untrusted github.event.comment.body in run script
violations.evidence: ${{ github.event.comment.body }} interpolated directly into run script
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted event fields via environment variables rather than direct shell interpolation.

violations.description: Deployment to internal registry via self-hosted runner and docker push without prior test validation step
violations.evidence: Internal build workflow builds and pushes docker image directly without any test step or needs gating
violations.recommendation: Add test validation jobs and require them via needs before executing deployment or push steps.

violations.description: Missing permissions block on a workflow running build and test on push and pull_request
violations.recommendation: Explicitly declare minimum required permissions blocks on workflows.

violations.description: Workflow interpolation of untrusted pull request title, body, and head.ref in run script
violations.evidence: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}, body, and head.ref interpolated in run script
violations.recommendation: Pass PR metadata via environment variables to prevent shell injection.
